about: No Memo's sounds. The files here are drawn by infra/nomemo/synth.py; infra/nomemo/sfx.py on the server makes ElevenLabs versions of those with a prompt (eleven) and the ship's voice lines, and the game prefers those when they exist. gain = loudness in the mix (0..1); every file peaks at -1 dB.

sounds.name: amb-sea
sounds.what: The sea round the hull, below decks
sounds.when: loops under the terminal while sound is on
sounds.eleven: Gentle sea swell heard from inside the wooden hull of an old sailing ship at night, slow waves, water lapping against planks, muffled, calm, no music

sounds.name: amb-hum
sounds.what: Lamp and tube: mains hum, a lantern's flicker
sounds.when: loops under the terminal while sound is on
sounds.eleven: Low electrical hum of an old CRT terminal and a flickering oil-lamp in a dark cabin, steady, faint crackle, no music

sounds.name: amb-tension
sounds.what: A low pulse under the deck
sounds.when: fades in while the trace has less than a quarter left, out when it ends
sounds.eleven: Slow low heartbeat pulse with a dark drone, tense, cinematic, steady tempo, no melody

sounds.name: creak-1
sounds.what: The hull creaks
sounds.when: now and then, every 9 to 26 seconds, one of three
sounds.eleven: Single wooden ship hull creak, old timber straining, close, dry, no water

sounds.name: creak-2
sounds.what: The hull creaks (long)
sounds.when: now and then, one of three
sounds.eleven: Long slow creak of a ship's mast and rope under strain, wooden groan

sounds.name: creak-3
sounds.what: The hull creaks (short)
sounds.when: now and then, one of three
sounds.eleven: Short sharp creak of a wooden ship deck plank

sounds.name: key-1
sounds.what: Keystroke
sounds.when: each key typed; one of four, never the same twice

sounds.name: key-2
sounds.what: Keystroke
sounds.when: each key typed

sounds.name: key-3
sounds.what: Keystroke
sounds.when: each key typed

sounds.name: key-4
sounds.what: Keystroke
sounds.when: each key typed

sounds.name: enter
sounds.what: Return key
sounds.when: a command is entered

sounds.name: send
sounds.what: Relay transmit chirp
sounds.when: a signed payment leaves for the relay

sounds.name: accepted
sounds.what: Command accepted
sounds.when: a step goes right (op step, riddle, sound on)

sounds.name: refused
sounds.what: Refused
sounds.when: the chain or the terminal says no

sounds.name: block
sounds.what: Ship's bell, far off: a new block
sounds.when: each new block while a contract is taken
sounds.eleven: Two strokes of a ship's bell far away in fog, muffled

sounds.name: tick
sounds.what: Trace clock
sounds.when: each new block while the trace has less than a quarter left

sounds.name: seal
sounds.what: Contract sealed: the wax stamp, then a bell
sounds.when: a contract settles
sounds.eleven: A heavy wax seal stamp pressed onto paper on a wooden table, then one small clear bell

sounds.name: paid
sounds.what: The share is paid: coins on wood
sounds.when: the drop pays a chapter's share back
sounds.eleven: A handful of old metal coins dropped and settling onto a wooden table, close, satisfying

sounds.name: mark
sounds.what: The crew's mark: a blade into the rail
sounds.when: the crew's mark (1 test AGRS) arrives
sounds.eleven: A knife carving a single notch into a wooden ship rail, then a low drum hit

sounds.name: dust
sounds.what: The Tracer: a ping out of the dark
sounds.when: dust from the lookalike wallet is found
sounds.eleven: Single eerie sonar ping in a dark ocean with a slightly detuned echo, tense

sounds.name: hunt
sounds.what: Hunt solved: minor resolves to major
sounds.when: the right lookalike is marked

sounds.name: chapter
sounds.what: Chapter done: a low horn and a bell
sounds.when: a chapter's four contracts are done (the card)
sounds.eleven: Distant low ship's horn swelling in fog, then one bright bell

sounds.name: mail
sounds.what: Mail aboard: telegraph dit-dit, a small bell
sounds.when: a crew message arrives
sounds.eleven: Old telegraph key tapping two short clicks and one long, then a tiny desk bell

sounds.name: board
sounds.what: The players' board: a ledger opened
sounds.when: board
sounds.eleven: An old leather ledger book opened and two pages turned, close

sounds.name: out
sounds.what: Trace complete: a falling klaxon, the line drops
sounds.when: the trace deadline passes on a taken contract

sounds.name: boot
sounds.what: The terminal comes on
sounds.when: the boot screen

voice.name: v-online
voice.when: the boot screen, when the live node answers

voice.name: v-refused
voice.when: the chain refuses a payment that was meant to go through

voice.name: v-dust
voice.when: dust from the lookalike is found

voice.name: v-paid
voice.when: the drop pays a chapter's share
